purpose: Hold the Layer-ROM state representation fixed and test whether physically justified storage-only inter-layer closures can recover fine-Reference interface fluxes before any reduced-state propagation.

trigger.prior_mechanism: work/f-rom-lare-rs1 LARE-DYN0A-MECH1 found gradient reconstruction dominant

state_representations.rule: No added gradient, moment, front-position or hidden profile state in A2.

immutable_reference.source: fine 16 x 10 cm B01 DYN0A fixed-flux Reference Richards artifact
immutable_reference.reference_face_flux: SWKMEAN=1 arithmetic fine-cell conductivity with native fine-cell head gradient, normalized positive downward

cohort.secondary: all fine-Reference cases already QUALIFIED in the immutable artifact
cohort.selection: frozen by predecessor DYN0A-MECH1 before A2 closure results

closures.role: changes conductivity localization only; gradient information is identical to the layer-centroid closure

definition: For each adjacent layer pair use local z=0 at the interface, upper domain [-L_i,0], lower domain [0,L_j].
Assume one continuous linear capillary-head profile psi(z)=a+b*z over the pair.
Solve a and b so numerical integration of theta(psi(z)) over each layer reproduces its exact layer-average theta.
Evaluate interface conductivity as K(psi(0)) and flux as q=K(psi(0))*(1+b).
No response data, fitted coefficient or additional dynamic state enters the reconstruction.
closures.numerical_route: deterministic Gauss-Legendre layer integration plus bounded nonlinear least-squares; fail closed if storage constraints or strict-unsaturated domain cannot be satisfied

diagnostic_oracles: EXACT_LAYER_MEANS: predecessor MECH1 exact volume means of psi and K, diagnostic only
LOCAL_K_MEAN_GRADIENT: predecessor MECH1 fine-interface K with layer-mean gradient, diagnostic only
structural_tests: uniform-state gravity identity: q=K(theta) for every candidate closure
synthetic linear-head reconstruction identity for C_HEAD_LINEAR
strict-unsaturated psi>0.01 cm at reconstruction quadrature and interface points
storage reconstruction residual <= 1e-11 theta in each layer
response_vector: per case/interface maximum absolute interface-flux error
pooled primary-cohort RMS error by partition and closure
pooled primary-cohort maximum absolute error by partition and closure
error at the critical Se0=0.95 DRY case
L3 versus L4 error change for the same closure at shared interfaces

adjudication.storage_only_closure_improvement: A candidate supports a storage-only closure improvement only if, on L3 primary high-state dynamics, it has no greater pooled RMS error, no greater pooled maximum absolute error and no more flux-sign mismatches than C_LARE_TAYLOR, with strict improvement in at least one of these components.
adjudication.broad_support: In addition, the candidate must not be worse than C_LARE_TAYLOR on both RMS and maximum absolute error in any primary case/interface block.
adjudication.resolution_interpretation: If L4 materially improves a closure while L3/L4 were A1 state-information equivalent, attribute the improvement to closure resolution/localization rather than added state information.
adjudication.escalation_rule: Only if all storage-only closures remain materially limited may A3 preregister an additional gradient/moment or front-position state.

provenance.reuse_rule: A2 may reuse constitutive constants, Reference parser and fine-face flux semantics with attribution, but the new closure implementation is persisted independently on work/f-rom-layer-a.
